mapper.select: select id, tenant_code, tenant_name, status, plan_code, expire_at, quota_product_max, quota_ai_call_day, create_time from sys_tenant where status = '0' order by id asc

SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM product p WHERE p.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND p.create_time >= #{startTime} AND p.create_time < #{endTime}) AS newProducts, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM trade_order o WHERE o.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND o.paid_at >= #{startTime} AND o.paid_at < #{endTime}) AS doneOrders, (SELECT IFNULL(SUM(o.total_amount), 0) FROM trade_order o WHERE o.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND o.paid_at >= #{startTime} AND o.paid_at < #{endTime}) AS doneAmount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM feed f WHERE f.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND f.audit_status = 'approved' AND f.create_time >= #{startTime} AND f.create_time < #{endTime}) AS newFeeds, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM twelve_runner_task t WHERE t.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND t.confirm_time >= #{startTime} AND t.confirm_time < #{endTime}) AS runnerDoneToday, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM twelve_runner_task t WHERE t.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND t.status = 'completed') AS runnerDoneTotal, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM twelve_runner_review r WHERE r.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND r.create_time >= #{startTime} AND r.create_time < #{endTime}) AS runnerNewReviews, (SELECT IFNULL(ROUND(AVG(r.rating), 1), 0) FROM twelve_runner_review r WHERE r.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND r.create_time >= #{startTime} AND r.create_time < #{endTime}) AS runnerAvgRating, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sys_tenant_renew_order ro WHERE ro.tenant_code = #{tenantCode} AND ro.status = 'paid' AND ro.paid_at >= #{startTime} AND ro.paid_at < #{endTime}) AS renewCount
SELECT user_id FROM sys_user WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND status = 0 AND del_flag = '0' ORDER BY user_id ASC
SELECT user_id FROM sys_user WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND status = 0 AND del_flag = '0' ORDER BY user_id ASC LIMIT 1
select id, tenant_id, report_date, title, content, stats_json, source, create_time, update_time from twelve_daily_report where tenant_id = #{tenantId} order by report_date desc, id desc
mapper.insert: insert into twelve_daily_report (tenant_id, report_date, title, content, stats_json, source, create_time) values (#{tenantId}, #{reportDate}, #{title}, #{content}, #{statsJson}, #{source}, NOW())
mapper.update: update twelve_daily_report set title = #{title}, content = #{content}, stats_json = #{statsJson}, source = #{source}, update_time = NOW() where tenant_id = #{tenantId} and report_date = #{reportDate}
